title: 第1754章 总算找到你了第1753章 双瞳同体
slug: 瞎婿第1754章总算找到你了
content_zh:
陆可欣俏脸瞬间一沉：“坏了！
那些魔族进来了！”
话音未落，一个面目狰狞的魔族女子出现在了半空当中。
她缓缓探出了一只魔爪，指向了下方昆仑宗众人。
“杀了他们，一个不留！”
密密麻麻的魔族，如同潮水一般，从四面八方，向着陆强等人冲来。
“快，防御！”
陆强拔出宝剑，手腕一抖，剑芒化作漫天星光，呼啸着斩向了那些魔族。
这些年来，陆强的实力，也是突飞猛进，修为早已经踏入了真仙初期。
因此这一剑的威力，非同小可，眨眼之间，便有数千个魔族，被当场斩杀，纷纷坠落在了地上。
然而即便如此，依旧有数之不尽的魔族，源源不断的冲了进来。
上万名昆仑宗弟子纷纷出手，与那些魔族混战在了一起。
虽然，大部分的魔族战斗力，不如这些昆仑宗弟子，可是却数量庞大，并且悍不畏死。
因此，只是一炷香的功夫，昆仑宗的阵营就被魔族冲的七零八落。
一个个昆仑宗弟子，纷纷倒在地上，而余下的昆仑宗弟子也都是陷入了惊恐绝望当中。
陆可欣奋力挥剑，将四周的魔族斩杀，可是更多的魔族，却是将她围住。
“嘿嘿，人类小丫头，果然一个个长得如此水灵，这若是玩起来，肯定爽死！”
一个高大魔族淫笑起来。
“老魔，你这家伙太过粗鲁，哪个到你的手里，不到一炷香就被吃的只剩下个皮，害的兄弟们都没有快乐上！”
“就是，老魔，今天让我们先来！”

其他魔族同样一脸怪笑的围了上来，并且纷纷伸出了魔爪。
狰狞的魔爪，从四面八方向着陆可欣抓了过来。
“不要！”
陆可欣望着眼前这可怕的一幕，不禁绝望大吼起来。
然而就在这个时候，天空当中，突然风云突变，只见密密麻麻的剑虹，从天而降，仿佛下起了一场七彩剑雨。
而更恐怖的是，那些七彩剑虹，如同长了眼睛一般，目标只有那些魔族。
眨眼的功夫，便有密密麻麻的魔族被剑虹击穿，并且纷纷爆开，变成了一团团黑烟，飘散虚空。
陆可欣四周的魔族，很快就被清空，她震惊不已，抬眼看向半空，只见一男两女，并肩而立。
“天铭，清雪！”
当陆可欣看清三人的模样之后，内心顿时变得狂喜起来。
而不仅是她，陆强，宋忠义，炎帝，在场之人，全部笑了起来。
他们期盼的救星，终于来了！
侥幸没有被剑雨击杀的魔族，惊恐后撤，如同潮水一般，退到了四周。
楚天铭见此，立刻带着韩清雪和杨千珏，从虚空飘然落地，出现在了陆强等人跟前。
“强哥，师姐，师兄，炎帝……”
楚天铭向着众人一一抱拳行礼。
“天铭，你可算回来了，你再晚来半步，我们怕是都要被这些魔族给吸成了肉干。”
content_en:
Lu Kexin's pretty face suddenly sank: "It's broken!
Those demons are coming in! "
Before he finished speaking, a ferocious-looking demon woman appeared in mid-air.
She slowly stretched out a claw and pointed it at the Kunlun Sect below.
"Kill them, leave no one behind!"
The densely packed demon clan was like a tide, rushing towards Lu Qiang and others from all directions.
"Quick, defend!"
Lu Qiang pulled out his sword, flicked his wrist, and the sword light turned into starlight, whistling and slashing at the demons.
Over the years, Lu Qiang's strength has also improved by leaps and bounds, and his cultivation has already entered the early stage of true immortality.
Therefore, the power of this sword was extraordinary. In the blink of an eye, thousands of demons were killed on the spot and fell to the ground.
However, even so, there were still countless demons rushing in continuously.
Tens of thousands of Kunlun Sect disciples took action one after another, fighting with those demons.
Although most of the demons are not as powerful as these Kunlun Sect disciples, they are huge in number and fearless of death.
Therefore, with just a stick of incense, the Kunlun Sect's camp was rushed to pieces by the demons.
One by one, the Kunlun Sect disciples fell to the ground, and the remaining Kunlun Sect disciples also fell into panic and despair.
Lu Kexin swung her sword with all her strength and killed the surrounding demons, but more demons surrounded her.
"Hehe, the little human girls, they all look so lively. It would be really fun to play with them!"
A tall demon laughed lewdly.
"Old Demon, you are too rude. If anything comes into your hands, it will be eaten away in less than a stick of incense, leaving only the skin. This will make your brothers unhappy!"
"That's right, Old Devil, let us go first today!"
Other demons also gathered around with strange smiles on their faces, and stretched out their claws.
The ferocious claws grabbed Lu Kexin from all directions.
"No!"
Lu Kexin looked at the terrible scene in front of her and couldn't help but yell in despair.
However, at this moment, the wind and clouds suddenly changed in the sky, and dense sword rainbows were seen falling from the sky, as if there was a rain of colorful swords.
What's even more terrifying is that those colorful sword rainbows seem to have eyes, and their targets are only those demons.
In the blink of an eye, densely packed demons were penetrated by the sword rainbow, and exploded one after another, turning into clouds of black smoke and floating into the void.
The demons around Lu Kexin were quickly cleared away. She was shocked. She looked up in the air and saw a man and two women standing side by side.
"Tian Ming, Qing Xue!"
When Lu Kexin saw the appearance of the three people clearly, her heart suddenly became ecstatic.
Not just her, Lu Qiang, Song Zhongyi, Emperor Yan, and everyone present laughed.
The savior they had been waiting for had finally arrived!
The demons who were lucky enough not to be killed by the sword rain retreated in fear, retreating to the surrounding areas like a tide.
Seeing this, Chu Tianming immediately took Han Qingxue and Yang Qianjue, floated to the ground from the void, and appeared in front of Lu Qiang and others.
"Brother Qiang, Senior Sister, Senior Brother, Emperor Yan..."
Chu Tianming saluted everyone with fists in his hands.
"Tian Ming, you are finally back. If you had come even half a step later, we would all have been sucked into dried meat by these demons."
